New services must use **`gateway-api`**. The deciding file is [`policy/ingress-class/v3.yaml`](https://github.com/dshnayder-org/infra/blob/git-access-ab/r10000/policy/ingress-class/v3.yaml) on branch `git-access-ab/r10000` of [dshnayder-org/infra](https://github.com/dshnayder-org/infra) — it is the only version of that policy marked `status: current`.

## The deciding lines

Verbatim from `policy/ingress-class/v3.yaml`:

```
# policy: ingress-class
# version: v3   effective: 2026-04-19   status: current
# subject: which ingress implementation new services must use
apiVersion: policy.meridian.io/v1
kind: FleetPolicy
metadata:
  name: ingress-class-v3
spec:
  effectiveFrom: 2026-04-19
  status: current
  setting: gateway-api
```

Its `effectiveFrom: 2026-04-19` is in the past as of today, so it is in force.

## The superseded versions (do not use)

| File | `setting` | `status` | `effectiveFrom` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `policy/ingress-class/v1.yaml` | `nginx` | `superseded` | `2024-03-11` |
| `policy/ingress-class/v2.yaml` | `gce-ingress` | `superseded` | `2025-06-02` |
| `policy/ingress-class/v3.yaml` | `gateway-api` | `current` | `2026-04-19` |

`v1.yaml` says `setting: nginx` with `status: superseded` and its header reads `version: v1   effective: 2024-03-11   status: superseded by v2`. `v2.yaml` says `setting: gce-ingress` with `status: superseded` and header `version: v2   effective: 2025-06-02   status: superseded by v3`. Both are historical — quoting either as the rule would be wrong.

## Caveats worth knowing

- **Nothing else in the repo mentions ingress.** A case-insensitive search across all `10001` tracked files for `ingress`, `gateway-api` or `nginx` matches only those three policy files — no ADR (all `300` under `docs/adr/`), no runbook, no CI workflow (`.github/workflows/check-00.yml` … `check-59.yml`), and no Gatekeeper/Kyverno/OPA constraint references them.
- **No cluster or service pins a version.** Nothing outside `policy/` references `ingress-class` or `FleetPolicy` by name, so version selection rests entirely on the `status:` field inside the files themselves. `policy/base.yaml` only carries `kind: FleetPolicyBase` / `spec.inherit: true` and names no policy.
